name: theme
description: The light theme paints the chrome, and the custom CSS of the settings still wins over the theme.

steps.title: Settings
steps.expression: const theme = document.getElementById('theme'); theme.value = 'light'; theme.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return theme.value;

steps.why: the app has a moment to apply and to save
the chrome of the light theme is white
the chrome bar is painted in the light colour
the text of the light theme is dark

steps.title: Settings
steps.expression: const field = document.getElementById('custom_css'); field.value = ':root{--accent:#ff6600}'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); document.getElementById('save').click(); return field.value;
steps.why: a custom colour is typed into the settings and saved
the app has a moment to apply and to save
the custom colour wins over the theme of the kit
the light theme is still in place under the custom CSS
